name: Port Royal
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Port Royal?
answer_short: Yes, under the state rule. In Port Royal, a permitted golf cart may use secondary roads posted 35 mph or less, within 4 miles of the registration address. Ribaut Road is a primary road. The town has allowed equipped carts at night; a faster road is still closed.

golf_cart.roads: Secondary roads posted 35 mph or less

rules.rule: Permitted golf carts on secondary roads posted 35 mph or less, in daylight, within 4 miles of the registration address, unless the city sets a different hour rule
Golf carts are not allowed on a primary highway such as US 21 (Ribaut Road)

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Port Royal?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Ribaut Road in Port Royal?
faq.a: No. It is a primary highway.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart at night in Port Royal?
faq.a: The town has allowed night use when the cart has lights. The road still has to be a secondary road posted 35 mph or less.
